title: How every new lead gets followed up
intro: LeadPro catches every digital lead and keeps following up by text and email until your team reaches them, then reminds them to sign once the Vine Sign agreement goes out. Your team still does what it does today: call, qualify on the first call, and sign.

sections.html:
Two jobs, clearly split

LeadPro does

  • Collects leads from your website forms, website chat, Facebook ads and tracked phone calls
  • Sends an instant thank-you text and email
  • Follows up for 4 days until your team reaches the lead
  • Sends signing reminders after the Vine Sign link goes out
  • Alerts Cyrus if an agreement is still unsigned after 4 days
  • Keeps checking in by email for about 3 months with leads you couldn't reach or who aren't ready yet
  • Emails Cyrus and your case manager the moment a client signs
  • Keeps every text and email in one inbox

Your team keeps doing

  • Calling every new lead
  • The consultation, on that first call
  • Sending the agreement through Vine Sign
  • Opening the case in FileVine
  • One new habit: moving the lead's card after each call

On this page, “messages” always means both texts and emails. No booking step and no double entry: moving the card is what tells LeadPro to start or stop messaging.

The flow at a glance

Blue boxes are LeadPro working automatically. The green box is the handoff to Cyrus and your case manager. Scroll sideways on a phone.

Your team's daily routine

  1. Open the board

    Every lead is a card showing the name, phone, email and where it came from.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Your team

  2. Call every new lead, newest first

    Start with the Web Lead and Phone Lead columns. The lead already has a thank-you text and email. Can't reach them? Leave the card where it is: LeadPro keeps following up for you.

    Where: your phone · Your team LeadPro follows up

  3. Spoke to them? Move the card

    Drag it to Lead Contacted, or Lead Qualified if it's a case you want. The new-lead messages stop.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Your team, one drag

  4. Not ready yet? Move it to Lead Thinking

    For a good case that wants time to think, with no agreement sent yet. LeadPro checks in by email for about 3 months so the lead doesn't go cold.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Long-term follow-up starts

  5. Signed on the call? Move it to Agreement Signed

    Cyrus and your case manager both get an email with the client's details right away, and every follow-up stops.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Cyrus + case manager emailed

  6. Sent the Vine Sign link? Move it to Agreement Sent

    The column is called "Agreement Sent – Awaiting Signature". LeadPro sends signing reminders until they sign, and alerts Cyrus on Day 4 if they haven't.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Reminders start

  7. Answer replies

    Texts and emails leads send back appear in one inbox. Reply there, or call them.

    Where: Conversations · Your team

  8. Not a case or spam? Close it

    Move the card to Lead Rejected or Lead Referred, or set its status to Lost. Nothing more is sent.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · Your team

  9. Before you leave, check Agreement Sent

    Anyone who signed today? Move them to Agreement Signed so the reminders stop.

    Where: Opportunities → Lead Stages · End of day

sections.html:
Messaging rules built in

Monday–Friday, 8 AM–6 PM Houston timeProposed hours: nothing goes out at night or on weekends. You can choose a longer window or add weekends (see open items).
Replies stop the sequenceOnce a lead answers, the automatic messages stop and your team takes it from there.
Opt-out always honoredEvery text names the firm and ends with “Reply STOP to opt out.”
No promisesMessages never mention results, case values or fees. They invite a call, nothing more.

Before and after

What changes for your team, based on our November 10 call.

AreaBeforeAfter
Where leads arriveChat leads come to the office inbox and are forwarded by email; Facebook leads arrive in a spreadsheetEvery digital lead (forms, chat, Facebook ads, tracked calls) is a card on one LeadPro board
Phone leadsNot tracked in LeadProCallRail is connected, so tracked calls land as Phone Leads
Leads you can't reachCalls and emails by hand for a few days, then the lead is droppedFollow-Up A sends 5 texts and 3 emails over 4 days, until your team reaches them
Leads that go quiet or aren't readyDropped after a few daysA long-term follow-up keeps checking in by email for about 3.5 months, until they reply or opt out
Unsigned agreementsWhoever sent the Vine Sign link chases it when they have timeStage 6 is now “Agreement Sent – Awaiting Signature”. Follow-Up B sends reminders and alerts Cyrus on Day 4
Consultation stagesThe standard setup sent booking reminders and show / no-show messagesThose stages stay on the board but send nothing: your first call is the consultation
Starting and stopping messagesNo automatic follow-upMoving a card starts or stops the right messages; a reply or STOP stops them too
Signed casesHanded to the case manager by handCyrus and the case manager get an email with the client's details the moment the card moves to Agreement Signed
Seeing who still needs a callNo way to see leads nobody has reachedEvery card sits in a stage, so open leads are visible at a glance
KPI scorecardShowed consultations booked, held and no-shows, which would always read zero for youLead → contacted → qualified → agreement sent → signed, with agreements measured against qualified leads
Message wordingTemplate copy written for any personal injury firmWritten for your firm, shown above for you to approve or edit before anything is sent
TextingNo texting numberEmails go first; texts switch on once your texting number is approved

Where things stand

Everything on this page is built in your LeadPro account and switched off. Nothing goes to a lead until you're happy with it. Here's how it goes live:

  1. You review the wording and answer the open items

    Change anything you'd like in the messages, and send us the answers below.

  2. We make your changes and send a test lead through

    We check every message arrives as written and stops when it should.

  3. We switch it on and walk your team through it

    The emails start right away. The texts start as soon as your texting number is approved.

Later, once this is running

Texts switch on as soon as your texting number is approved; until then the emails run on their own. After about two weeks of use we'll review the numbers on your KPI dashboard together. With a FileVine user from your team, we can connect LeadPro to FileVine so a signed client's case opens there automatically. None of these are switched on now.
